edges.reason: _botProtection constructor argument is forwarded to the BotProtected constructor.
BotProtected constructor stores _botProtection into the botProtection state variable.
owner is assigned from the untrusted msg.sender in the TidalToken constructor.
TidalToken constructor calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair.
The value returned by pairFor is stored into uniPair.
Constructor writes infinite allowances into the allowance mapping.
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier.
_from is encoded into the low-level external call inside the modifier.
_to is encoded into the low-level external call inside the modifier.
_value is encoded into the low-level external call inside the modifier.
msg.sender is used as the allowance spender inside transferFrom.
The modifier body placeholder executes the guarded transferFrom logic.
_value is subtracted from allowance without SafeMath, enabling underflow.
_from indexes the allowance mapping that is decremented unchecked.
Unchecked subtraction writes back into the allowance state variable.
_value is added/subtracted from balances without SafeMath.
_to receives an unchecked balance increment.
Unchecked arithmetic mutates balanceOf entries.
_to is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
_value is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
TidalToken.transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
_spender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
_value is written into the allowance mapping by approve.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Parameter a is the target of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter b is the arbitrary calldata of the delegatecall.
delegate() performs the unrestricted delegatecall.
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
list() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
block.timestamp + 600 builds the router deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
The external liquidity call is dispatched through the uniRouter state variable.
_numList is supplied as the token amount desired/minimum for addLiquidityETH.
list() invokes uniRouter.addLiquidityETH.
_tos entries are written into balanceOf inside the distribution loop.
_amounts entries are assigned to balanceOf regardless of totalSupply consistency.
Loop index i indexes _tos/_amounts when writing balances.
Loop index i drives the iteration inside list().
Reference ERC20.transfer calls _transfer.
Reference ERC20.transferFrom calls _transfer.
Reference ERC20.transferFrom calls _approve to reduce allowance.
Reference ERC20.approve calls _approve.
The low-level call to the untrusted botProtection contract executes before state changes and can re-enter transferFrom.
The external Uniswap router call can re-enter token transfer entry points during listing.
Arbitrary delegatecall executes foreign code in the token context, which can re-invoke owner-gated functions.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as an argument of TidalToken.transferFrom and flows into allowance/balance updates.
_to is only used inside TidalToken.transferFrom to credit balances.
_value is only used inside TidalToken.transferFrom for unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic.
_numList is only consumed by list() when supplying liquidity.
_tos is only consumed by the distribution loop in list().
_amounts is only consumed by the distribution loop in list().
_botProtection is only used by the TidalToken constructor to configure bot protection.
a is the target of the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation.
b is the calldata payload of the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation.
_to only exists to be forwarded from transfer() to transferFrom().
_value only exists to be forwarded from transfer() to transferFrom().
_spender only indexes the allowance mapping written by approve().
_value is only written into the allowance mapping by approve().
Loop counter i exists only inside the distribution loop of list().
